home.heading: We are here to listen.
home.lead: What happened? We are here to help you find a way forward.
home.action_talk_text: See how to reach a person for support.
home.tell_us: Tell us what happened. We will help you understand the next step.
home.danger_title: If you are in immediate danger
home.danger_text: Call now. This website does not call emergency services.
home.danger_note: If it is not safe to call, go to a safer place or to a trusted person if you can.
home.support_open_text: A trained person is available right now. You can start a private chat.
home.support_closed_text: No one is online right now. You can still send a report and track it with its reference.
home.support_link: See how to talk to someone
help.heading: I need help
help.lead: Find support for your situation. Choose the option that fits.
help.now_text: If someone is in danger, call 999 now.
help.now_safe_steps: For abuse or violence at home or outside, 109 is the helpline for women and children.
help.talk_open_text: You can start a private chat. A trained person will reply here. It is not an emergency service.
help.talk_closed_title: No one is available right now
help.talk_closed_text: Live chat opens only when a trained person is online during staffed hours. We do not show it as open when no one is there.
help.talk_alternatives: You can still do these now:
help.topic_help: This helps us choose the right person. You can say more in the chat.
help.talk_danger_help: Tick this if someone is in immediate danger. It moves your chat up the queue. It does not call emergency services.
help.report_text: If something harmful happened, you can report it safely. You can stay anonymous.
help.legal_text: Basic information and where to look for legal aid.
help.digital_text: What to do if your account is hacked or someone threatens you online.
support.closed_now: No one is available right now
stories.heading: Stories and corrections
stories.lead: Only material that has passed consent, safety, redaction and editorial review appears here.
stories.none_text: We publish only after careful review. Nothing is published from a private report without consent.
stories.corrections_text: When we get something wrong, we correct it here and say what changed.
about.heading: About Help Lagbe?
about.lead: Help Lagbe? is a secular service. It helps people find support, report harm safely, and reach a human who can help.
about.how1: You describe what happened and choose anonymous or confidential.
about.how2: A trained person reviews it and assigns a priority with written reasons.
about.how3: The right team acts: support, referrals you agree to, or information.
about.how4: Every sensitive access is logged. Nothing is published without consent and review.
about.safe1: We never contact a family member, employer or the person you report without your clear request.
about.safe2: Reports about children get the strictest handling. They are never published as stories.
about.safe3: Being given a priority is not a finding of guilt. A report is an allegation until a proper authority decides otherwise.
about.safe4: Every decision on a case is recorded with the name of the person who made it.
about.editorial_text: Stories are published only with consent, a safety review, checked sources, removal of identifying details, editorial review and, where needed, legal review. People named in a story can reply, and we publish corrections.
about.not1: We do not call the police, ambulances or other emergency services.
about.not2: We do not give legal advice. We give information and point to proper help.
about.not3: We do not use automated bots or AI to talk to you. Chat is always with a person.
safety.heading: Safety
safety.lead: Practical steps to stay safe, online and offline.
safety.now_title: If you are in danger now
safety.now1: Move to a safer place if you can. Stay with someone you trust.
safety.now2: Call 999 for immediate danger, or 109 for abuse against women and children.
safety.now3: Keep your phone charged and tell someone where you are.
safety.digital1: Change passwords you use in several places. Make each one long and different.
safety.digital2: Turn on two-step verification in your email and social accounts.
safety.digital3: Never share a one-time code, even with someone who says they are from a company.
safety.digital4: Before you block or report, keep screenshots that show the date and the account name.
safety.digital5: If an account is taken over, use the platform's account recovery page and tell your contacts not to act on messages from it.
safety.blackmail_text: Do not pay. Paying often leads to more demands. Keep the evidence, stop replying, block the account, and report it. Then tell us in Get help.
safety.legal_disclaimer: This is general information, not legal advice. A qualified lawyer should review your situation.
safety.legal_text: Government legal aid services can help people who cannot afford a lawyer. Ask for a legal aid service in your district, and keep the dates and evidence of what happened.
privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.lead: What we collect, who can see it, and how long we keep it.
privacy.review_notice: This policy is awaiting legal review before the service is launched.
privacy.anon_text: We do not ask for your name, phone or email. We cannot contact you directly. You follow the case with a reference and a one-time key.
privacy.conf_text: If you give your details, they are stored apart from your report and encrypted.
privacy.conf1: Only a worker assigned to your case can open them, and they must write a reason first.
privacy.conf2: Every time they are opened, the time, the person and the reason are recorded.
privacy.conf3: Confidential is not the same as absolute secrecy. A court order or a serious risk to life could require disclosure.
privacy.who_text: Staff see a case only when they are assigned to it or it is in their team's first review. Administrators manage staff and settings; they do not read cases. Every access is logged.
privacy.keep1: An unsent report expires after 24 hours and is then deleted.
privacy.keep2: Your one-time key is removed once you confirm you have saved it, or after two hours.
privacy.keep3: Confidential details can be removed after a case is closed, under our retention policy. Each removal is logged.
privacy.files_text: Files are checked for their type and size, stored encrypted, and never shown on a public page. Only assigned staff can open them, with a reason.
privacy.never1: Contact a family member, employer or the person you report, without your request.
privacy.never2: Publish your report. Only a reviewed, de-identified story can be published, and only with your separate consent.
privacy.never3: Sell your information or use it for advertising.
privacy.rights_text: You can track your case, add information, withdraw consent to publication, and ask for a correction. To raise a concern about how your information was handled, use the request form.
contact.heading: Contact
contact.lead: The fastest ways to get help or reach us are on this page.
contact.ways_track: See the progress of a report you made.
contact.ways_talk: Chat with a person when one is online.
contact.no_email: We do not publish a general email address yet. Use the forms on this site so your message reaches the right team.
contact.complaints_text: Tell us if you are unhappy with how we handled a report, a story or a staff member. A complaint about a staff member is never handled by that person.
contact.access1: You can use the whole site with a keyboard, and focus is always visible.
contact.access2: Switch between Bangla and English at the top of any page. Your answers in a report are kept.
contact.access3: Text can be made larger in your browser. The layout works on small phones.
contact.access4: Press Escape three times to leave this site at once.
contact.access_feedback: If something here is hard to use, tell us. Use the complaint form and say what is difficult.
track.heading: Follow your case
track.lead: Enter the reference and the one-time key you were given when you reported. No account is needed.
track.no_account: We show only the stage your report is at. We do not show internal notes.
track.not_proven: A review stage does not mean anything has been proven.
track.referred_note: A referral has been made. Its details are shared only with you as agreed.
track.next_received: A trained person will review your report. You can add information here at any time.
track.next_under_review: The team is looking at your report. We will update this page when the stage changes.
track.next_more_information: The team needs more information. Please reply below with what you can share.
track.next_referred: Your case has been referred to a service, with your agreement. You can ask about it below.
track.next_closed: This case is closed. If you think it was wrong, you can ask for it to be reviewed again below.
pstatus_help.received: Your report has reached us and is waiting for a trained person to review it.
pstatus_help.under_review: A team is looking at your report and deciding what can be done.
pstatus_help.more_information: The team needs something from you to continue. Reply on this page.
pstatus_help.referred: With your agreement, your case has been passed to another service.
pstatus_help.closed: The case is closed. You can still send a message or ask for it to be reviewed.
received.heading: Your report has been received
received.lead: Thank you. A person will review it. We cannot promise how soon. Save the two items below now. They are the only way to follow your case.
received.safety_title: You said someone may be in immediate danger
received.safety_text: Your report has been marked for priority review, so it moves to the top of the queue. No one has been alerted outside this system, and we have not contacted any emergency service. If it is safe, call now.
received.keep_text: We keep only a fingerprint of the key, so we cannot send it again. If someone else can see this device, write it down elsewhere.
received.next1: A person reviews the report and sets its priority with written reasons.
received.next2: It is passed to the right team, who may write to you on the tracking page.
received.next3: No referral or publication happens without your agreement.
received.saved_button: I have saved my reference and key
received.saved_note: This removes them from this screen, so they are not visible to anyone else who uses this device.
report.error_category: Choose the option that is closest. If you are not sure, choose 'Not sure yet'.
report.error_narrative_short: Please write at least a few words. Approximate details are fine.
report.error_narrative_long: This is too long. Please keep it under 20,000 characters.
report.error_need_phone: To be contacted by phone, add a phone number.
report.error_need_email: To be contacted by email, add an email address.
report.error_consent: You need to agree before we can send your report.
report.error_incomplete: Some answers are missing. We have taken you to the first one.
report.error_busy: Your report is already being saved. Please wait a moment and do not press the button again.

step.1.question: What happened?
step.1.help: Choose the closest option. You can explain more in the next steps.
step.2.question: Is anyone in danger right now?
step.2.help: Your answer helps us decide how quickly to look at this. It does not call anyone.
step.2.yes_desc: Someone is at risk now. Please call the numbers below if it is safe.
step.2.unsure_desc: You are worried but cannot tell how urgent it is.
step.2.no_desc: No one is in immediate danger right now.
step.2.safety_note: If someone is in immediate danger, call 999 first. This website does not call emergency services.
step.2.child: A child (under 18) is involved or affected
step.2.child_help: Reports about children are handled with stricter care and are never published as stories.
step.3.question: Tell us what happened
step.3.help: Write as much or as little as you can. Approximate details are fine.
step.3.prompt_when: When did it happen? (roughly is fine)
step.3.prompt_where: Where did it happen? (an area is enough)
step.3.prompt_who: Who was involved? You can describe people without naming them.
step.3.warning: Do not write passwords, one-time codes, bank or card details. We do not need them.
step.3.narrative_help: In your own words, in Bangla or English.
step.3.when_help: For example: last Tuesday evening, or over the past month.
step.3.where_help: An area or type of place is enough. Do not write a home address.
step.4.question: How do you want to report?
step.4.help: Both options are safe. The difference is what we can know about you.
step.4.anonymous_desc: We do not collect a name, phone or email. We cannot contact you directly. Follow the case with a reference and key.
step.4.confidential_desc: Your details are stored apart from your report and encrypted. Only an assigned worker can open them, with a reason. This is confidential, not absolutely secret.
step.4.who1: Only staff assigned to your case, and only with a written reason.
step.4.who2: Administrators manage staff and settings. They do not read cases.
step.4.who3: Every access is recorded with the time and reason.
step.4.who4: A court order or a serious risk to life could require disclosure. We will not promise absolute secrecy.
step.4.details_help: Fill in only what you are comfortable with. Everything here is optional.
step.4.name: Name you want us to use
step.4.do_not_contact: Anyone we must never contact about this
step.4.safe_notes: Anything else about contacting you safely
step.4.consent_contact: I agree to be contacted in the way I chose above
step.5.question: Add files (optional)
step.5.help: Screenshots, photos, documents or recordings can help. You can skip this step.
step.5.rules: Up to {max} files. Each upload can be at most {mb} MB in total.
step.5.choose_help: Files are checked, stored encrypted and never shown publicly.
step.6.question: Check your report
step.6.help: Read it once more. You can change any step. Nothing is sent until you press the button below.
step.6.consent_process: I understand how this report will be handled, and I agree that Help Lagbe? staff may review it.
step.6.consent_help: Required. You can read more in the privacy policy.
step.6.consent_publication: A fully de-identified version may be considered for publication after review.
step.6.consent_publication_help: Optional. Without this, nothing from this report is published. You can withdraw later.
step.6.no_auto: We do not publish your report, and we do not contact anyone outside the platform on your behalf.
step.6.submit_note: It is sent once. You will see your reference and key only after it is saved.
category.harassment_desc: Repeated teasing, insults or unwanted behaviour, on the street, at school or work, or online.
category.threats_blackmail_desc: Someone threatens you, or demands money or favours to keep something secret.
category.abuse_violence_desc: Physical, sexual or emotional abuse, including at home.
category.corruption_exploitation_desc: Bribes, misuse of a position, unpaid work or being taken advantage of for money.
category.online_harm_desc: A hacked account, private photos shared or threatened, or harassment online.
category.child_safety_desc: Any worry about a child being hurt, neglected or exploited.
category.other_desc: A concern that does not fit the options above.
category.not_sure_desc: You want to talk it through. A person will help decide.
privacy.hosting_logs: Our hosting provider keeps short-term technical logs that can include IP addresses. We do not add them to your report or to our case records.
step.4.details_only_confidential: These details are used only if you choose a confidential report. If you report anonymously, they are not stored.
